title: Session slots never exceed the cap when processes race for a slot
body:
Source: CI run 43966983067 (PR #1266): session-cap test saw 3 live sessions under cap 2; reproduced locally 1 of 15.
Cause: tryTake created the slot with flag wx and wrote the pid after; a concurrent reader saw an empty file, judged it stale and reclaimed a live slot.
Outcome: node --test test/evals/session-cap.test.ts exits 0 and the cross-process cap test passes 30 of 30 runs.
Proof: the empty-slot regression test fails on the old code and passes on the fix.
